basis: Inherited disruption of vitamin metabolism; no additional organ damage applies consistently across this umbrella.
Hereditary periodic bone pain defines the musculoskeletal localization; no other organ involvement is established.
Fatty acid oxidation defect; cardiomyopathy, encephalopathy and rhabdomyolysis each occur in 80-99%; common hepatic dysfunction omitted by the four-axis cap.
Neurodegeneration is near-universal; skeletal disease is common and hearing loss occurs in 80-99%; skin disease omitted by cap; hepatomegaly alone does not establish dysfunction.
Opportunistic bacterial infection umbrella; no single anatomical site is consistently affected across the group.
Familial erythrocytosis with increased hemoglobin and hematocrit in all reported patients; vascular complications are not defining organ damage.
Muscular dystrophy and cardiac disease define the EDMD phenotype; ventricular septal hypertrophy is reported, although cardiac frequency in this subtype is uncertain.
Immunodeficiency, developmental delay and abnormal sulfur amino acid metabolism define the syndrome; atrial septal defect occurs in 2/4 patients.
Inherited renal tubular amino acid transport disorder causing cystine wasting and urinary stone formation.
Biliary atresia and splenic malformation define BASM; congenital cardiac defects occur in roughly 40-50%.
Systemic hypersensitivity with airway compromise and circulatory dysfunction as major diagnostic manifestations; transient rash and gastrointestinal symptoms add no axes.
Purely psychiatric anxiety disorder without defining damage to an organ axis.
Creatine synthesis defect; cerebral creatine deficiency causes developmental impairment in most patients across AGAT and GAMT deficiencies.
Brucella canis infection; constitutional symptoms and splenomegaly do not establish common additional organ dysfunction.
Inherited color-perception phenotype with an eye abnormality annotation; functional severity and additional manifestations are poorly specified.
Roseolovirus infection umbrella; typical roseola rash is transient, and encephalitis does not affect most patients across the group.
Inherited cone-rod retinal degeneration causing progressive visual impairment and macular atrophy.
Direct autonomic peripheral nerve damage; underlying diabetes is a separate disease, and individual visceral complications are variable.
Familial restrictive cardiomyopathy is defined by myocardial dysfunction.
Malignant astrocytic tumor arising in the central nervous system.
Benign ovarian epithelial neoplasm; reproductive origin without a defining endocrine disorder falls outside the axes.
Inflammation of the lip, classified here within the mouth; inflammation alone does not establish an immune-mediated mechanism.
Psychotic disorder explicitly outside the axes; psychiatric cognitive symptoms do not independently establish neurologic organ damage.
Congenital abdominal wall closure defect with herniation of bowel; the bowel displacement and musculofascial wall defect define the condition.
Congenital narrowing of the trachea; associated structural cardiovascular and pulmonary artery abnormalities are annotated as frequent (30-79%).
